text:
liam: Quick sync: PM asked for a "Permissions preview (dry-run)" in the console so admins can see routing & quota impacts before committing.
nora: Nice. Are we talking about a simulated evaluation against current traffic or a static diff of rules?
liam: ideally both. static diff is cheap. simulated eval uses sampled traffic in sandbox to estimate real-world impact (quota hits, route changes).
diego: sampling + simulation is heavy. we should restrict simulated eval to admin-only, and rate-limit it. also provide an estimated error bound.
sara: UX idea: show two toggles: "Preview (static)" and "Simulate (traffic)". default to static. show ETA for simulate run.
liam: API question: do we add a new endpoint POST /v1/permissions/dry_run or extend existing /introspect?
nora: prefer a dedicated endpoint that returns an evaluation report, structured: {affected_routes, quota_delta_est: {route: delta_pct}, sample_traffic_match: n}.
diego: internal debate: should the evaluator do routing policy selection (cost-tier fallback) exactly like runtime? duplicating logic risks drift; better to call a sandboxed runtime to get faithful behavior.
sara: sandboxed runtime implies infra. maybe cheaper: replay sampled requests through the real router but mark them dry-run and not bill. router can run policy and emit a "dry_eval" event.
liam: replay approach is appealing. but we need to guarantee it won't affect caches or evict KV entries. need sandbox flag all the way through.
nora: another telemetry ask: emit metrics for dry-run accuracy by comparing predicted vs observed after rollout: `perm_preview.accuracy_pct` and `perm_preview.predicted_quota_delta` gauge.
diego: for rollout UX, add a step: preview -> simulate -> commit with staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%). console should surface a rollback button and a summary of simulation results.
sara: technical note: previews must be idempotent and safe to run concurrently by multiple admins. implement as jobs with a TTL and dedupe key (admin_id + mutation_hash).
liam: mutation_hash = sha256(sorted(change_set)). avoids accidental double work.
nora: security: only org-admins or delegates can run simulate. log who ran it and for what change. also redact PII in sampled payloads.
diego: routing policy nuance: some routes have quota knuckles (granular throttles) and others have pooled quotas. preview needs to understand both models.
sara: initial MVP: static diff + small sampled replay limited to 1k requests. that should give useful signal without infra lift.
liam: timeline: nora -> design report schema, diego -> implement replay dry-run in router (flag + event), sara -> console UI toggles + staged rollout wiring. target: next sprint.
nora: one more: console should link to a dashboard panel showing "recent permission simulations" with heatmap by route and a sparklines for `quota.delta_est` vs actual post-rollout.
diego: add alert rule: if actual quota increase > predicted + 30% for any route, trigger `perm-preview-regression` pager.
liam: pm-bot: feature ticket created: https://redwood/tasks/PRIV-8693. assign nora/diego/sara, priority P2.
sara: i'll spike a UI mock and put it in the design doc.
nora: i'll draft report schema and sample payloads tonight.
diego: i'll add the dry-run flag to router and emit `dry_eval.result` events. will also add `perm_preview.run.time_ms` metric.
liam: thanks. small follow-up: do we want a quick static-only preview now? we can ship that as an opt-in before simulation.
sara: yes ship static preview first. reduces risk and gives PM something to demo. :rocket:
